'''W2-7AY''' was a brown-colored [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], that was owned by [[Thaedius Creed]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After some of Creed's emlpoyees went missing on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], he sent W2-7AY to find the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in [[Hedrett]]. 7AY found them and presented them with a recording that Creed had made, requesting that they met with him.
